messages.siteDescription: Add names, spin the wheel, and make a choice together.
messages.historyEmpty: No results yet. Spin the wheel to make the first pick.
messages.localDataDescription: Participant names and round results stay on this device.
messages.editorHint: Add names, one person on each line.

messages.intro: Add names and spin the wheel. Your next choice is a moment away.
messages.resultIdle: Your next pick will appear here
messages.storageFailed: Could not save to local storage. Spins are paused; download the session as JSON to preserve its history.

messages.importFull: The session limit is reached. Delete a saved session before importing another.
messages.importError: The backup could not be imported. Existing sessions are unchanged.
messages.sessionSwitchError: Could not switch sessions in this browser tab.
messages.footerTagline: An experience made for the moment of choice

messages.deleteSessionError: The session could not be deleted. It remains saved.
messages.historyPruneWarning: This session stores 10,000 results. Continuing removes the oldest result. Download a complete JSON backup first if you want to keep it.
